title: Solutions + Pro Services weekly sync notes - 2026-05-26
content:
Attendees: Samir Patel (SE lead), Avery Chen (Solutions Eng), Priya Nanduri (Pro Services PM), Liam O'Connor (CS), Marisol Ruiz (SRE)

Meeting goal: weekly status for active integrations, identify blockers, confirm next milestones and owners. Quick call, focused on customer go-lives and unstable test flows.

High-level summary:
- Acme Corp: On track for pilot in staging next week; small routing issue remains (see blocker).
- Finch Health: Delayed by security review (customer side). Parallel work on private deployment checklist continues.
- OptiRetail: Performance regressions observed at high concurrency; SRE investigating autoscaling policy.
- NovaBank: Compliance docs delivered; waiting on infra approval and cert for VPC peering.

Notes by customer:

1) Acme Corp (ecomm integration)
- Status: staging verification in progress; pilot planned for 2026-06-02.
- This week: Completed prompt templates and end-to-end smoke tests for checkout assistant flows. Latency baseline ~220ms p50 on dedicated nodes.
- Blockers: Intermittent 5xx from routing layer when requests route across AZs. Seen ~1.2% error rate in stress tests.
- Owner (blocker): Marisol to follow up with infra (ticket PROJ-4471) and confirm sticky routing config by 2026-05-28.
- Next steps: Samir to run round of A/B prompts with caching enabled and report token cost delta by 2026-05-27.
- Linked artifacts: GitHub PR 312 (fixed logging), smoke-test logs attached to Jira PROJ-4523.

2) Finch Health (healthcare customer, private deployment)
- Status: paused due to customer's security review. Our private package and KMS integration docs sent 2026-05-20.
- This week: PM sync with customer security; they requested HSM integration pattern and SOC2 excerpts. Priya working on clarifications.
- Blockers: Customer legal wants FIPS cert confirmation before infra approval. We don't have direct FIPS HSM offering in the private package yet.
- Owner (action): Priya to surface fallback options (cloud KMS w/ dedicated keys vs. HSM partner) on 2026-05-29.
- Next steps: Prepare a short one-pager comparing options and incremental effort. Also schedule a joint call with security on 2026-06-01.

3) OptiRetail (large-scale retail query rerank + embeddings)
- Status: integration tests pass at baseline QPS but show tail-latency spikes at peak load.
- This week: SRE ran load tests with burst strategy; observed KV cache miss patterns that correlate with tail spikes.
- Blockers: Autoscaler cooldown is causing slow scale-up under sudden traffic bursts. Need tuning of the burst policy and faster warm-start of models.
- Owner (SRE): Marisol to propose autoscaler tuning and model warm-start plan by 2026-05-28.
- Owner (SE): Avery to replicate failure locally and create reproducible test harness (due 2026-05-27).
- Notes: Consider pre-warming smaller model variant as fallback to reduce user-visible errors while autoscale completes.

4) NovaBank (financial services, private)
- Status: compliance doc set delivered; waiting on customer's infra team to approve VPC peering and certs.
- This week: Legal/Compliance finished review; small privacy clause edits requested.
- Blockers: Customer's infra calendar is thin this quarter, so VPC peering slots are delayed ~2 weeks.
- Owner (procurement): Liam to nudge and coordinate with account team and provide an escalation path if no slot found by 2026-06-03.
- Next steps: Prepare low-risk demo environment that uses temporary approved network path while peering is scheduled.

Cross-customer and internal items:
- Rollout/playbooks: Need to update the 'private-deployments' runbook to include HSM fallbacks and a checklist for customer-provided certs. (Action: Priya, due 2026-06-04)
- Observability: Add per-route percentile dashboards for customers on Dedicated to expose p95/p99 to customers. (Action: Avery + Observability team, scope doc by 2026-05-30)
- Cost modeling: Samir will run unit-cost analysis for Acme with caching on vs off; include token and infra delta (deliverable 2026-05-27).
- KB / enablement: Create a short internal guide: 'Handling autoscaler tail-latency for retail workloads' (owner: Marisol, draft 2026-06-02).

Decisions made:
- For OptiRetail, we will implement a two-tier fallback: small quantized variant pre-warmed + autoscaler tuning. Decision agreed by SRE/SE.
- For Finch Health, we will offer a KMS + partner-HSM migration path as an approved short-term solution; PD will not block pilot signoff (if customer accepts documented tradeoffs).

Action items (owner - due):
- Marisol Ruiz - investigate routing 5xx across AZs for Acme; update PROJ-4471 with root cause hypothesis (2026-05-28).
- Samir Patel - run Acme caching cost analysis and A/B prompt runs (2026-05-27).
- Avery Chen - build local harness for OptiRetail concurrency repro and attach to Jira PROJ-4523 (2026-05-27).
- Priya Nanduri - prepare HSM fallback one-pager and schedule security call with Finch (2026-05-29 / 2026-06-01).
- Liam O'Connor - coordinate with NovaBank infra to secure VPC peering slot or temporary demo path (2026-06-03).
- Marisol Ruiz - draft KB for autoscaler tail-latency mitigations (2026-06-02).

AOB / quick notes:
- Customer feedback: Acme asked for per-customer throttles in the console UI; product will review feasibility (ticket RDW-2890).
- Internal: consider adding a lightweight smoke-test suite to the onboarding checklist to catch AZ routing issues earlier.
- Next sync: 2026-06-02, same time. If urgent blockers appear, ad-hoc escalation channel is #solutions-pro-services on Slack.

Notes to self / TODOs (informal):
- capture sample p95/p99 traces for OptiRetail and attach to runbook; may need small instrument change to surface KV cache hits/misses.
- follow up with infra on sticky routing experiment results (was run 2026-05-25) and see if results reduce 5xx.

Attachments: links to smoke-test logs and load test dashboards in Jira tickets above.

End of notes.
